# Deterministic native-PDF anchor fixture

`native_anchor.pdf` is the frozen Phase 0 native-text fixture generated by
`generate_native_anchor.py`. The generator profile is
`reportlab-native-anchor-v1` and requires ReportLab `5.0.0`.

Regenerate the fixture from the repository root with:

```powershell
.venv\Scripts\python.exe tests/fixtures/pdfs/generate_native_anchor.py --output tests/fixtures/pdfs/native_anchor.pdf
```

Frozen properties:

- PDF byte size: `2470`
- SHA-256: `2d9c30592721d5e27f39c6a047f4e10f2577868d0ac1ef836a81dbdb8180175e`
- Page size: US Letter, `612 x 792` PDF points
- Page count: `2`
- Physical-page labels: `A-6`, `A-7`
- Unique page-two sentence: `The anchor sentence reports an accuracy of 91.2 percent.`

The generator uses only the built-in Helvetica font, fixed document metadata,
ReportLab invariant mode, and uncompressed page streams. Two independent runs
must produce byte-identical files before the frozen PDF is updated.
